review_candidates.description: About Docker Docker is the platform at the center of how intelligent software gets built. For more than a decade, Docker has helped millions of developers and thousands of organizations build, ship, and run software consistently across any environment. Today, Docker extends that same trust to the AI era. Docker Hardened Images form the foundation agentic code is built on, local and cloud Docker Sandboxes isolate where agents run, and Docker AI Governance sets enterprise-wide policy. Together, they give builders and organizations the confidence to adopt any model, tool, or agent without compromising security, governance, or control. _______________________________________________________________________ About The Role Docker Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) embed directly with our most strategic customers to solve important, complex technical problems and turn ambitious ideas into production outcomes. FDEs take on the most challenging technical problems using existing Docker products and patterns when possible, and work across customer, Docker Product and Engineering teams to realize new approaches when required. The Sr. Principal FDE is a rare, deeply specialized role at the frontier of the practice, whose expertise shapes Docker's long-term direction. You are accountable for outcomes that are strategic, cross-functional, and often company-defining: the customer relationships, technical patterns, and product capabilities that determine how the world's largest organizations adopt agentic AI on Docker. You work as a trusted advisor and partner to executive leadership, both at Docker and at our most strategic customers, and you are recognized internally and externally as a leader in the field. You take on the most consequential customer challenges, often with no established playbook, and own the technical journey from discovery and architecture through production rollout. More importantly, you turn what you learn into an advantage: reference architectures, engagement standards, product direction, and the next generation of FDE leaders. You work with broad latitude and the work you do shapes Docker products and services. _______________________________________________________________________ Responsibilities Lead Docker's Most Strategic Customer Engagements Serve as the technical lead on Docker's most strategic and highest-stakes customer engagements, from first prototype through stable production rollout, often across multiple customers and workstreams at once. Use existing Docker products and patterns when possible; invent, prototype and validate new approaches when necessary. Deliver working technical artifacts that set the bar for the practice: custom MCP servers with tightly integrated Docker Sandbox environments for coding agents and containerized agents; Docker Compose definitions for multi-agent harnesses and model-backed applications; Hardened Image standardization and migration at enterprise scale; and new tools that unblock customer progress. Integrate Docker's AI platform with the customer's existing stack, including identity providers (OIDC/SAML/SSO), secrets management, private and air-gapped registries, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling. Own technical delivery on your engagements and set the delivery standard for others: scope the work, sequence it, make trade-offs between speed and quality, remove blockers early, and contribute directly to code whenever progress depends on it. Act as a trusted technical advisor to customer CTOs, CISOs, and senior engineering leaders, aligning them on architecture, risk, and adoption strategy. Make AI Adoption Safe and Governable Translate customer security, compliance, and platform requirements into concrete plans and see them through from ideation to production. Define the reference frameworks and controls that let customers adopt agentic AI to solve their unique business problems without compromising security, compliance, data sovereignty, or end-user experience.
